stages.name: Pricing & Transaction Value Optimization
stages.description: Structuring pricing to maximize revenue per transaction without losing customers.

strategies.title: Introduce Value Bundles
strategies.detail: Group 2-3 frequently bought items into a combo priced 10-15% below individual total. This raises average basket size while giving customers a perceived deal.

strategies.title: Tiered Pricing for Repeat Buyers
strategies.detail: Offer small loyalty discounts (2-5%) on frequently repurchased items for customers who buy above a threshold. This encourages higher per-visit spend.
strategies.expected_impact: Raises transaction frequency and avg_ticket together.

strategies.title: Strategic Markdowns on Slow Movers
strategies.detail: Identify items with inventory_turnover below 2x/month and apply time-limited markdowns (15-25%) to free up working capital for faster-selling stock.
strategies.expected_impact: Improves inventory_turnover and frees cash for high-demand products.

stages.name: Customer Retention & Loyalty
stages.description: Building repeat-customer habits and reducing churn through loyalty programs and personalized engagement.

strategies.title: Launch a Simple Punch-Card Loyalty Program
strategies.detail: Give customers a physical or digital punch card — buy 5 times, get 10% off the 6th visit. Low-tech, high-impact habit loop.

strategies.title: Personalized Follow-Up for Lapsed Customers
strategies.detail: Track customers who haven't visited in 2+ weeks. Send a simple WhatsApp message with a small welcome-back offer (5-10% off next purchase).
strategies.expected_impact: Recovers 15-25% of lapsed customers at minimal cost.

strategies.title: Prioritize Service for Top 20% of Customers
strategies.detail: Identify your highest-frequency customers and offer them priority — early access to new stock, reserved items, or personal greetings. Retention of high-value customers is worth 3-5x acquiring new ones.
strategies.expected_impact: Reduces churn among highest-revenue customers by 30%+.

stages.name: Local Marketing & Footfall Growth
stages.description: Low-cost, high-impact marketing tactics to drive more foot traffic and local awareness.

strategies.title: Street-Level Signage & Visual Merchandising
strategies.detail: Invest in clear, visible signage within 50m of the shop. Use bright colors, large fonts, and 2-3 key offers. Physical signage has the best cost-per-impression for local businesses.
strategies.expected_impact: Increases footfall_per_day by 10-25% with one-time investment.

strategies.title: Weekly Micro-Promotions
strategies.detail: Run one small promotion per week (e.g., 'Tuesday 10% off on dairy') announced via WhatsApp groups or a small poster. Consistency beats intensity.
strategies.expected_impact: Steadily increases footfall on specific days, smoothing revenue across the week.

strategies.title: Partner with Neighboring Shops
strategies.detail: Cross-promote with 2-3 nearby non-competing businesses (e.g., a chai stall sends customers to you, you send customers to them). Shared flyers or bundle deals.
strategies.expected_impact: Expands local reach without increasing marketing_spend_monthly significantly.

stages.name: Digital Payments & Tech Adoption
stages.description: Moving toward digital transactions and basic tech tools to improve efficiency, traceability, and customer convenience.

strategies.title: Promote UPI with a Small Discount
strategies.detail: Offer a flat ₹5-10 discount on UPI payments for transactions above ₹200. This nudges cash-paying customers toward digital while keeping margins intact.

strategies.title: Set Up a Simple Digital Inventory System
strategies.detail: Use a free POS app (e.g., Khatabook, Vyapar) to track stock digitally. This reduces manual counting errors and helps spot fast/slow movers.
strategies.expected_impact: Reduces inventory losses by 5-10% and improves reorder decisions.

strategies.title: Collect Basic Customer Contacts (Opt-In)
strategies.detail: Ask willing customers for their phone number at checkout for WhatsApp updates. Build a list of 100-200 customers over time for direct, free marketing.
strategies.expected_impact: Creates a zero-cost marketing channel for future promotions.

stages.name: Inventory & Operations Efficiency
stages.description: Optimizing stock management, supplier relationships, and daily operations to reduce waste and improve margins.

strategies.title: ABC Inventory Analysis
strategies.detail: Classify inventory into A (top 20% items, 80% revenue), B (next 30%, 15% revenue), C (bottom 50%, 5% revenue). Focus management attention on A-items, reduce C-item depth.
strategies.expected_impact: Improves inventory_turnover by 20-40% and frees working capital.

strategies.title: Negotiate Better Terms with Suppliers
strategies.detail: For items you reorder weekly, negotiate 7-15 day payment terms instead of cash-on-delivery. This improves cash flow without changing prices.
strategies.expected_impact: Frees 1-2 weeks of working capital for reinvestment.

strategies.title: Daily 10-Minute Operations Review
strategies.detail: Spend 10 minutes each closing reviewing: what sold out, what didn't move, and any customer complaints. Small daily habits compound into better decisions.
strategies.expected_impact: Reduces waste and improves stock-out rate by 15-25% over time.
